stories.title: Government to function as normal while Burnham on holiday
stories.summary: Burnham's government continues normally during his summer break, despite opposition taunts about 'bunking off' after his first-week spending commitments.

stories.title: Burnham chairs emergency Cobra on disposable barbecues amid wildfires
stories.summary: PM Burnham chaired an emergency Cobra meeting over the weekend over wildfire risks linked to disposable barbecues, urging retailers to act voluntarily.

stories.title: Who's in Andy Burnham's new Labour cabinet?
stories.summary: Burnham's full cabinet includes Mahmood (Home), Healey (Chancellor), Miliband (Foreign), Streeting (Defence), and Haigh as First Secretary — a significant reshuffle from the Starmer era.

topics.name: Burnham Gov Intelligence
topics.description: Procurement, tech/AI, spending, vendor & priority signals

stories.title: 🤖 AI minister role boosted but DSIT axed in Burnham shake-up
stories.summary: Burnham has scrapped DSIT, redistributing its functions to BIST and DCMS, while establishing a Cabinet Office-led AI task force. Tech leaders warn of slower policymaking.

stories.title: 🤖 GDS to keep name and controls remit
stories.summary: The Government Digital Service will retain its brand and oversight functions under the new DCMS-led structure, providing continuity for digital public services.

stories.title: 🤖 Stephanie Peacock confirmed as digital government minister
stories.summary: Peacock takes on oversight of GDS, data infrastructure, and digital public services under the restructured DCMS.

stories.title: 🤖 UK government has awarded over 2,000 AI contracts
stories.summary: AI procurement is accelerating with 2,000+ contracts awarded, though AI accounts for just 4% of the total value of government tech procurement.

stories.title: 🤖 HM Treasury: AI adoption has moved from experimentation to organisation-wide use
stories.summary: Treasury confirms its internal AI tools are now deployed organisation-wide, signalling growing government confidence in scaling AI.

stories.title: 🏗️ UK to strip back procurement rules to focus on job creation
stories.summary: First Secretary Louise Haigh signals procurement requirements for Whitehall contracts will be revised to prioritise job creation — a significant policy shift.

stories.title: 🤝 Consultants to lose £3bn of UK government work under Burnham
stories.summary: The Burnham government is planning to cut £3bn from consulting spend across Deloitte, EY, KPMG, PwC, McKinsey, BCG, Bain and Accenture.

stories.title: 🏢 'Tech Prosperity Deal' Binds UK to US AI Dominance Strategy
stories.summary: Analysis warns the UK's Tech Prosperity Deal — including Microsoft's £22bn and Amazon's £8bn commitments — locks the UK into US-led AI infrastructure with strategic dependency risks.

stories.title: 💰 Burnham's first-week pledges: £1.5bn in commitments, some unfunded
stories.summary: BBC Verify found Burnham's first-week commitments total ~£1.5bn, with the largest item (£850m VAT cut on electricity) flagged as unfunded.

topics.name: Labour Party

stories.title: Burnham chairs Cobra on disposable barbecue wildfire risk
stories.summary: An emergency Cobra was convened over the weekend as wildfires linked to disposable barbecues prompted urgent government action, with retailers urged to stop selling them voluntarily.

stories.title: Benefits ban for foreign nationals would include EU citizens
stories.summary: Labour's planned benefits restrictions for foreign nationals are confirmed to include EU citizens, raising questions about the policy's compatibility with UK-EU relations.

topics.name: Conservative Party
topics.description: Conservative party news, Kemi Badenoch, opposition

stories.title: Kemi Badenoch's 'weird week': ex-neo-Nazi candidate raises questions over Tory vetting
stories.summary: A former neo-Nazi was selected as a Tory candidate in Somerset; Badenoch's defence prompted widespread criticism about whether the party has truly changed.

stories.title: Badenoch overtakes Farage as favourite to be next PM
stories.summary: Betting markets now place Badenoch as more likely than Farage to be next PM. Her combination of ideological clarity and political fluency is building opposition credibility.

stories.title: Badenoch announces foreign nationals social housing ban
stories.summary: Conservatives announced they would evict foreign nationals with leave to remain from social housing — condemned by charities and accused by Reform of being policy plagiarism.

topics.name: Liberal Democrats
topics.description: Lib Dem party news and policy positions

stories.title: Lib Dem council to ask for election delay
stories.summary: A local Liberal Democrat council is seeking a delay to scheduled elections, weeks after Ed Davey raised concerns about council readiness for electoral processes.

topics.name: Reform UK
topics.description: Nigel Farage, Reform UK party news

stories.title: Farage wins Clacton by-election with 22,239 votes; major parties boycotted
stories.summary: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage returned to Parliament via a self-triggered Clacton by-election, winning easily against novelty candidates after Labour, Conservatives and Lib Dems boycotted.

stories.title: Farage faces renewed parliamentary watchdog probe and Metropolitan Police investigation
stories.summary: Parliamentary authorities resumed a probe into Farage's failure to register a £5m gift from a billionaire donor. The Met Police is also investigating Reform UK donations.

stories.title: Questions over Farage's summer absence and Reform's direction
stories.summary: Reports suggest Farage was largely absent from public life through July–August, raising questions about Reform UK's ability to sustain momentum without its leader's active media presence.

stories.title: Scottish Conservatives win Aberdeen South in shock by-election loss for SNP
stories.summary: The SNP lost Aberdeen South to the Scottish Conservatives in a by-election, the latest blow to the party struggling with the Murrell embezzlement fallout.

stories.title: SNP accused of 'embezzling voters' over Peter Murrell's misuse of funds
stories.summary: Opposition leaders accused the SNP of betraying voters after Peter Murrell, former party chief executive, was convicted of embezzling £400,000 in party funds.

topics.name: Cabinet Office
topics.description: Government reshuffles, senior appointments, cross-department policy

stories.title: Full ministerial appointments published: Burnham's July 2026 cabinet
stories.summary: The King approved a comprehensive list of ministerial appointments on 20 July 2026, including Healey as Chancellor, Miliband as Foreign Secretary, and Haigh as First Secretary and Cabinet Office minister.

stories.title: Louise Haigh confirmed as de facto deputy PM and Cabinet Office minister
stories.summary: Haigh is serving as First Secretary of State, Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster, and Cabinet Office minister — making her the operational hub of cross-departmental coordination.

topics.name: Elections & By-elections
topics.description: Upcoming or recent election results, polls

stories.title: Farage wins Clacton by-election; Count Binface comes second with 9,455 votes
stories.summary: Farage won the Clacton by-election with 22,239 votes after triggering it himself. With major parties absent, Count Binface came second in what analysts called 'one of the most surreal election nights' in recent British politics.

stories.title: 2026 local election results: Reform gains, Conservative wipeout in some areas
stories.summary: The 2026 local elections showed Labour holding ground, Reform making gains, and Conservatives losing councillors in several boroughs including Havering.
